title: Sort Packages
real_world_story: A logistics company receives packages in random order. Before loading them, the system needs to arrange the packages from lightest to heaviest so that loading can be planned systematically.
problem_statement: Given an array containing the weights of N packages, sort the package weights in non-decreasing order.
task: Arrange all packages from the lightest to the heaviest.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing package weights.
output_format: Print the package weights in non-decreasing order.

examples.explanation: The packages are arranged from the lightest weight to the heaviest weight.
The package weights are sorted in non-decreasing order, keeping equal weights together.

expected_algorithm.reason: The problem is designed to practice basic sorting techniques for organizing packages before loading.

hint: Compare package weights that are out of order.
Continue until all package weights are sorted.
real_world_takeaway: Sorting packages by weight can help logistics systems organize and plan cargo loading more effectively.
